layout: uint8, x fastest then y then z, value/255 * mu_max_per_mm = linear attenuation in 1/mm
source: CTLiver (Medical Decathlon Task03_Liver imagesTr/liver_100.nii.gz), CC BY-SA 4.0, via the 3D Slicer sample data collection
processing: cropped to the body above -400 HU, resampled to 2.6 mm isotropic, HU converted to linear attenuation and quantised to 8 bits
